about_the_game:
You wake to find yourself trapped in a condemned tunnel, your way back blocked by a sudden collapse—and something unnatural advancing from the darkness behind. The only hope is to move forward, guiding your battered car through an endless maze of concrete and fog. Every second, a relentless mist creeps closer, warping your senses and twisting the tunnel into something unrecognizable. You’ll need to drive, scavenge, improvise, and confront your fears if you want to survive. There are no second chances here: every decision counts, and hesitation could be your last.

  • First-person survival horror with tense driving and on-foot exploration

  • Procedurally generated tunnel: every run offers new puzzles and dangers

  • Dynamic environmental obstacles: blocked paths, broken machinery, locked doors

  • Immersive sound and visuals: a suffocating, ever-changing atmosphere

  • One-way progression: learn, adapt, and try again—each run brings you closer to escape

Your car is your only lifeline as you navigate the endless, twisting tunnel. Dodge debris, manage your dwindling fuel, and use your headlights to cut through the fog. But be prepared—sooner or later, you’ll have to leave the safety of your vehicle to push forward.

Roadblocks, collapsed passages, and broken systems force you to explore on foot. Search every corner for tools, supplies, and clues. Each step is a risk: the mist brings hallucinations, strange noises, and lurking threats that grow more intense the longer you linger.

Tunnel 19 is a run-based experience where every attempt is different. Obstacles, item locations, and environmental hazards change with each new run. Learn from your failures, master the layout, and gradually uncover the secrets hidden in the dark.

content_descriptors.notes:
“Horror” sequences where the player is confronted with creatures that can perform actions considered violent.
The environments can sometimes be a little gloomy/morbid.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10-11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Trapped in a condemned tunnel, survive the advancing mist by switching between tense driving, exploration, looting, and solving environmental puzzles. Every decision matters as you try to escape a threat that never stops closing in.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Vietnamese
